The hedge fund run by Bruce Silver held 53,267 shares of the capital goods company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $838,000, down from 124,109 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Silver Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Spartan Mtrs Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $569.99M market cap company. (NASDAQ:SPAR) has risen 125.83% since May 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 114.28% the S&P500.
